svg.title: Slussen data platform layers
svg.desc: Source teams land contract-bound batches in S3; a contract gate validates them into a Parquet lake; Snowpipe loads the Snowflake medallion warehouse; Gold marts serve Power BI reports and Cortex Analyst.
svg.text: From source team batches to governed reporting: every number on the dashboard traces back through a contract-checked load
Reconciliation, freshness and data quality checks every 4 hours
Silver and Gold are Snowflake dynamic tables; Gold refreshes within 12 hours
